hints: Collect terms in $5^x$ to solve for $5^x = \dfrac{5}{12}$, then take logarithms to find $x$ correct to 3 decimal places.
walkthrough:
Rearrange the equation to isolate terms involving $5^x$:
$$10 = 25(5^x) - 5^x$$
$$10 = 24(5^x)$$
$$5^x = \dfrac{10}{24} = \dfrac{5}{12}$$

Take the natural logarithm of both sides:
$$\ln(5^x) = \ln\left(\dfrac{5}{12}\right)$$
$$x\ln 5 = \ln 5 - \ln 12$$

Calculate the numerical values step by step:
$$\ln 5 \approx 1.6094379$$
$$\ln 12 \approx 2.4849066$$
$$\ln 5 - \ln 12 \approx 1.6094379 - 2.4849066 = -0.8754687$$
$$x = \dfrac{-0.8754687}{1.6094379} \approx -0.543959 \dots$$

ai_rubric.Solving Exponential and Logarithmic Equa: Uses index laws correctly to solve for $5^x = 5/12$ (M1). Applies logarithms to solve $5^x = 5/12$ (DM1). Obtains $x = -0.544$ correct to 3 d.p. (A1).
